items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: He could never play with a band like Cab Calloway, which I was with for 11 years.

ctx.x: I saw what you said in Stanley's piece. You said he was a wonderful trumpet player.

Oh, yeah, he was a good trumpet player, but he's just eight years younger and you couldn't hold him down, you know. He would never be able to play with a band. I was always hoping. Of course I didn't see him much after I left, and then I heard about him, you know. Guys talking, "Hey, your brother's down in Kentucky there blowing a good horn," you know. So I thought well, maybe I'll open a way for him, you know, as best as I can, you know. But he was one of them types of guys, he had to have his way. He could…
Not in Cab's band, would it.
